images.title: Empty trail
images.note: Candidate scene root: horizontal crossing, near white trunk, right fallen log. The foreground trunk sits a little farther inside the left edge than the brief sketches.

images.title: Couple A
images.note: The first ordinary acceptable pair. Pale satin, gloves, pinned hair, dark suit and bow tie. Partner-facing profiles, no lens look.

images.title: Couples B, C and D
images.note: Supporting cast reference only: three additional pairs, six people. Couple A joins them in the film.

images.title: One couple enters
images.note: Entry study: the pair is barely breaking the left crop boundary and will pass behind the near trunk. This is deliberately flagged for staging review before motion; the cast and clothes hold.

images.title: The layered crossing begins
images.note: Corrected layered start: A in the middle distance, B emerging beside the near trunk, C small and dim farther back. All six survive the crop. D enters later in the take.

images.title: All eight are already looking
images.note: Eight visible faces and sixteen reflected eye-points, with better separation into depth. Candidate ending look: the older pair still needs to sit farther back before the final motion anchor.
